Darren Oorloff, Pleasure Planet “Pure Romance” artwork

A square artwork of chrome mannequin heads in a warped checkerboard room, with a pink gradient sphere, warped stripes, and a vertical title strip.

Source
AIGA Eye on Design (5 September 2019): “Acid Graphics” Are the New Psychedelia
Creator
Darren Oorloff
Made
Not stated (before September 2019)
Style
Acid graphics (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Surreal, cool, synthetic
Evidence
Inspected the 1200 px image Darren-Oorloff-PP-Pure-Romance.jpg that Eye on Design published with the article, in a scratch folder. Not stored. The object is a digital image as the magazine published it, not a named physical copy. The caption reads “Darren Oorloff, PP, Pure-Romance, as featured on @acidgraphix”. The square format suggests a record cover, but the source does not say so.
Reviewed
2 October 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

Eye on Design shows the work in its 2019 article on acid graphics, with the caption “Darren Oorloff, PP, Pure-Romance, as featured on @acidgraphix”.

Observed

  • Black-and-white checkerboards cover the floor and walls of a room and bend in perspective.
  • Two bald mannequin heads in profile face each other. Their surfaces are rendered as dark, reflective metal.
  • A red-to-violet gradient sphere sits on the checkerboard floor, and a red-pink doorway glows in the back wall.
  • A strip at the left holds “PLEASURE PLANET” in condensed capitals running vertically, “PURE ROMANCE” in italic capitals, the kanji 愛, and a panel of wavy red stripes.
  • Diagonal glitch cuts split the image near the left edge.

Why it belongs

The work shows the op-art and chrome-figure side of the trend that Eye on Design lists, with a pink palette that brings it close to vaporwave. It is a boundary case for this record.

Borrow

Bend a checkerboard into a room to give a flat layout depth.

Run the title vertically in a narrow strip beside the image.
